single_asset_rally_capture_is_the_cap.why: a long-only spot book holding w of NAV in the rallying asset and the rest in USDT at 0% ends a rally of R at 1 + w*R, so its capture ratio IS w. The cap is the capture ceiling; no signal can raise it.

both_legs_rally_together.note: gross_cap 0.80 is NOT reachable: the only assets with a cap above the satellite 0.05 are BTC and ETH, and 0.40 + 0.30 = 0.70. The USDT floor of 0.20 is therefore never the binding constraint either.
